paragraphs.source_en: I sit alone on a stone halfway up the hill, watching white clouds rise in vapour before the peak, a small, nameless sparrow mocking my bewildered spirit. The white clouds rise in round, swelling masses, then dissolve into a distant, boundless expanse; Yet in my narrow, pressured heart, ah, it gathers only tragic mist and clouds of sorrow! Clear morning light has already begun to break, washing the green-island-like peak before me clean; Like the dim phosphorescence amid ruined graves, there is a faint spark within my breast. Yet this one dim, weak spark, casts light on the remains and the embers; even so, a mockery of what has passed, yet it steadily follows time in silence. Composed before March, 1925

units.source_en: I sit alone on a stone halfway up the hill, watching white clouds rise in vapour before the peak, a small, nameless sparrow mocking my bewildered spirit.
units.source_zh:
我獨坐在半山的石上，

看前峰的白雲蒸騰，

一隻不知名的小雀，

嘲諷著我迷惘的神魂。

units.source_en: The white clouds rise in round, swelling masses, then dissolve into a distant, boundless expanse;
units.source_zh:
白雲一餅餅的飛升，

化入了遼遠的無垠；

units.source_en: Yet in my narrow, pressured heart, ah, it gathers only tragic mist and clouds of sorrow!
units.source_zh:
但在我逼仄的心頭，啊，

卻凝斂著慘霧與愁雲！

units.source_en: Clear morning light has already begun to break, washing the green-island-like peak before me clean;
units.source_zh:
皎潔的晨光已經透露，

洗淨了青嶼似的前峰；

units.source_en: Like the dim phosphorescence amid ruined graves, there is a faint spark within my breast.
units.source_zh:
像墓墟間的燐光慘淡，

一星的微燄在我的胸中。

units.source_en: Yet this one dim, weak spark, casts light on the remains and the embers; even so, a mockery of what has passed, yet it steadily follows time in silence.

units.source_zh:
但這慘淡的弱火一星，

照射著殘骸與餘燼，

雖則是往跡的嘲諷，

卻綿綿的長隨時間進行！

paragraphs.source_zh:
我獨坐在半山的石上，

看前峰的白雲蒸騰，

一隻不知名的小雀，

嘲諷著我迷惘的神魂。

白雲一餅餅的飛升，

化入了遼遠的無垠；

但在我逼仄的心頭，啊，

卻凝斂著慘霧與愁雲！

皎潔的晨光已經透露，

洗淨了青嶼似的前峰；

像墓墟間的燐光慘淡，

一星的微燄在我的胸中。

但這慘淡的弱火一星，

照射著殘骸與餘燼，

雖則是往跡的嘲諷，

卻綿綿的長隨時間進行！

一九二五年三月前作
